title: Cartas: Ed Universe
sum: 36 cartas de hq, com o local de cada uma.
body:

en.title: Cards: Ed Universe
en.body:
- Comic, 36 cards. Locations from IGN's list; tick each one as you grab it.
- Back to [[colecao-cartas]].
